methods.ProdOui: transform important functions into real testable implementations rather than mockups
methods.SACREBLEU: reconstruct from multiple sources and double-validate when reconstruction is required
methods.snapshot: for a task, preserve an instant-T evidence snapshot when the host workflow provides a protected storage destination
methods.triangulation: use the exact request instant as primary anchor; compare other snapshots only as separately timestamped secondary points

operatingRules: Prefer a working minimal graft over a parallel replacement architecture.
Keep public and private data boundaries explicit.
Simulate or inspect before destructive changes.
When a function can operate offline, do not make internet connectivity a hard dependency.
Do not claim a capability is operational until its actual path has been tested or directly verified.
